items.q: What did the grade-3 teacher get wrong about 除法竖式?
items.a: He budgeted **4 periods**. It took ~**20** to get 80–95% fluent. The official pace is a **top-10%** document. [[burden-cut-cuts-reps]] then forbids the extra 16.

items.q: When is 减负 actually 义务坐牢?
items.a: When the kid sits a whole period in a daze because grade-3 never locked. Midnight homework is fog, not grit. Real cut = minutes that **land**.

items.q: What are the three mastery layers?
items.a: [[three-mastery-layers]]: follow the recipe → cook blind and fast → write the recipe. Stay at 1 and thinking never trains. **没有重复，就没有思维.**

items.q: Why do the top 30% look fine until high school?
items.a: [[fake-can-do-until-selection]]. Talent covers layer 1 through 小初. Short video + tutoring 大招 never name layers 2–3. October density shows the fake 会.

items.q: What does home do when school 减负?
items.a: [[invert-school-load]]: school cuts basics → you add time on 竖式-class skills. School piles work → you cut volume and repeat the few items to layer 3. DeepSeek can check the rule.

items.q: Why leave kids bored on purpose?
items.a: Screens keep 知觉 on instant reward. Weekly no-phone sport / talk / hands. Boredom that forces a use is the transfer. Slow now is fast later.
